title: Hello, world: building my portfolio in public
excerpt: Why I built my portfolio with Angular and FastAPI, and what I'm planning to write about.
content:
I decided to build my portfolio like a real product: an Angular front end, a Python FastAPI backend, and a small retrieval-based assistant that can answer questions about my work.

Over the next few weeks I'll write about the AI agent I'm building, lessons from deploying language models locally, and how I think about retrieval-augmented generation.
